mapper.sql: CASE WHEN r.purchase_order_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'ORDER' WHEN r.status='HISTORY' THEN 'HISTORY' ELSE 'DIRECT' END
FROM tb_goods_receipt_item i JOIN tb_goods_receipt r ON r.goods_receipt_id=i.goods_receipt_id JOIN tb_supplier s ON s.supplier_id=r.supplier_id

COUNT(*) line_count, COALESCE(SUM(i.supply_amount),0) supply_amount,COALESCE(SUM(i.vat_amount),0) vat_amount,COALESCE(SUM(i.total_amount),0) total_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.tax_type='TAXABLE' THEN i.supply_amount END),0) taxable_supply_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.tax_type='TAXABLE' THEN i.vat_amount END),0) taxable_vat_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.tax_type='TAX_FREE' THEN i.supply_amount END),0) tax_free_supply_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.tax_type IS NULL THEN i.supply_amount END),0) unknown_tax_supply_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.purchase_order_id IS NOT NULL THEN i.total_amount END),0) order_total_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.purchase_order_id IS NULL AND r.status<>'HISTORY' THEN i.total_amount END),0) direct_total_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.purchase_order_id IS NULL AND r.status='HISTORY' THEN i.total_amount END),0) history_total_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.amount_source='ORDER_ESTIMATE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) estimate_line_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.amount_check_status='UNCHECKED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) unchecked_line_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.amount_check_status='PRICE_DIFF' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) price_diff_line_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.amount_check_status='QTY_DIFF' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) qty_diff_line_count
mapper.select:
SELECT g.*,
(SELECT a.account_name FROM the_full.tb_account a WHERE a.account_id=g.group_key LIMIT 1) (SELECT su.supplier_name FROM tb_supplier su WHERE su.supplier_id=g.group_key) g.group_key group_name FROM ( SELECT r.account_id DATE_FORMAT(r.receipt_date,'%Y-%m') DATE_FORMAT(r.receipt_date,'%Y-%m-%d') CAST(r.supplier_id AS CHAR) group_key,
GROUP BY group_key ) g ORDER BY g.group_keyg.total_amount DESC,g.group_key

SELECT b.purchase_order_item_id,COUNT(*) bill_line_count,SUM(b.billed_qty) billed_qty,SUM(b.supply_amount) supply_amount, SUM(b.vat_amount) vat_amount,SUM(b.total_amount) total_amount, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT b.tax_type)=1 THEN MAX(b.tax_type) END tax_type FROM tb_supplier_bill_line b WHERE b.purchase_order_item_id IN #{id} GROUP BY b.purchase_order_item_id

SELECT i.goods_receipt_item_id,i.goods_receipt_id,i.purchase_order_item_id,i.received_qty,i.unit_price, i.supply_amount,i.vat_amount,i.total_amount,i.tax_type,i.amount_source,s.supplier_code FROM tb_goods_receipt_item i JOIN tb_goods_receipt r ON r.goods_receipt_id=i.goods_receipt_id JOIN tb_supplier s ON s.supplier_id=r.supplier_id WHERE i.purchase_order_item_id IN #{id} ORDER BY i.purchase_order_item_id,i.goods_receipt_item_id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_goods_receipt r SET total_supply_amount=(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.supply_amount),0) FROM tb_goods_receipt_item i WHERE i.goods_receipt_id=r.goods_receipt_id), total_vat=(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.vat_amount),0) FROM tb_goods_receipt_item i WHERE i.goods_receipt_id=r.goods_receipt_id), total_amount=(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.total_amount),0) FROM tb_goods_receipt_item i WHERE i.goods_receipt_id=r.goods_receipt_id) WHERE r.goods_receipt_id=#{goods_receipt_id}
mapper.select: SELECT s.supplier_id,s.supplier_code,s.supplier_name,COUNT(*) line_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(oi.unit_price_snapshot*b.billed_qty-b.supply_amount)<=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) excludes_vat_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(oi.unit_price_snapshot*b.billed_qty-b.supply_amount)>1 AND ABS(oi.unit_price_snapshot*b.billed_qty-b.total_amount)<=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) includes_vat_count FROM tb_supplier_bill_line b JOIN tb_account_purchase_order_item oi ON oi.purchase_order_item_id=b.purchase_order_item_id JOIN tb_supplier s ON s.supplier_id=b.supplier_id WHERE b.bill_date>=#{from_date} AND b.bill_date<=#{to_date} AND b.billed_qty>0 AND b.vat_amount>0 AND b.account_id=#{account_id} GROUP BY s.supplier_id,s.supplier_code,s.supplier_name

SELECT s.supplier_id,s.supplier_code,s.supplier_name,COUNT(*) line_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(i.unit_price*i.received_qty-i.supply_amount)<=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) excludes_vat_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(i.unit_price*i.received_qty-i.supply_amount)>1 AND ABS(i.unit_price*i.received_qty-i.total_amount)<=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) includes_vat_count FROM tb_goods_receipt_item i JOIN tb_goods_receipt r ON r.goods_receipt_id=i.goods_receipt_id JOIN tb_supplier s ON s.supplier_id=r.supplier_id WHERE r.purchase_order_id IS NULL AND i.amount_source='SUPPLIER' AND i.received_qty>0 AND i.vat_amount>0 AND r.receipt_date>=#{from_date} AND r.receipt_date<=#{to_date} AND r.account_id=#{account_id} GROUP BY s.supplier_id,s.supplier_code,s.supplier_name

SELECT s.supplier_code,s.supplier_name,DATE_FORMAT(b.bill_date,'%Y-%m-%d') bill_date,b.account_id,b.client_ord,b.client_ord_item, b.supplier_item_code,COALESCE(oi.product_name_snapshot,'') product_name,b.billed_qty, oi.unit_price_snapshot order_unit_price,b.unit_price bill_unit_price,b.supply_amount,b.vat_amount,b.total_amount FROM tb_supplier_bill_line b JOIN tb_account_purchase_order_item oi ON oi.purchase_order_item_id=b.purchase_order_item_id JOIN tb_supplier s ON s.supplier_id=b.supplier_id WHERE b.bill_date>=#{from_date} AND b.bill_date<=#{to_date} AND b.billed_qty>0 AND ABS(oi.unit_price_snapshot*b.billed_qty-b.supply_amount)>1 AND ABS(oi.unit_price_snapshot*b.billed_qty-b.total_amount)>1 AND b.account_id=#{account_id} ORDER BY b.bill_date DESC,b.supplier_bill_line_id DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT s.supplier_code,s.supplier_name,b.account_id,po.client_ord,oi.client_ord_item,oi.purchase_order_item_id, COALESCE(oi.product_name_snapshot,'') product_name,oi.item_status, DATE_FORMAT(MAX(b.bill_date),'%Y-%m-%d') bill_date,SUM(b.billed_qty) billed_qty,SUM(b.total_amount) total_amount FROM tb_supplier_bill_line b JOIN tb_account_purchase_order_item oi ON oi.purchase_order_item_id=b.purchase_order_item_id JOIN tb_account_purchase_order po ON po.purchase_order_id=oi.purchase_order_id JOIN tb_supplier s ON s.supplier_id=b.supplier_id WHERE b.bill_date>=#{from_date} AND b.bill_date<=#{to_date} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_goods_receipt_item gi WHERE gi.purchase_order_item_id=b.purchase_order_item_id) AND b.account_id=#{account_id} GROUP BY s.supplier_code,s.supplier_name,b.account_id,po.client_ord,oi.client_ord_item,oi.purchase_order_item_id,oi.product_name_snapshot,oi.item_status HAVING SUM(b.billed_qty)<>0 ORDER BY bill_date DESC LIMIT 100
